Hi Tom. I’m Noor. I’ll be your buddy for your first month. Have you enjoyed your first week here?
Yes, everyone is very friendly, and my teachers answered all the questions I asked them. On my first day, Mr Miller and I walked around the school, and he showed me some of the facilities here.

On Tuesday, I followed Droov to his classes, and he helped me find my way around. I especially liked my first music class, we watched a documentary about a really interesting band, and listened to some of their songs! On Thursday, we cooked our own pizzas, which I really enjoyed.
That sounds like a lot of fun! And what happened on Wednesday?
Oh ... yes! On Wednesday, I joined in one of the PE lessons and we played a football match for the entire hour. I worried about not making friends, but all my classmates are lovely.
That’s nice that you feel more comfortable now. When I moved here, I used to feel the exact same way, but things soon started to get better!

Oh, really? It’s nice that I’m not the only one with those feelings! Today also ended positively! I wanted to catch up on my classes, so I worked in the library at lunchtime, and studied for a science test that we have next week.
